settings.question: How quickly will my order be shipped?
settings.answer: At Cool Mom Sprinkles, we strive to process and ship all orders within 24 to 48 hours, typically exceeding expectations with shipments often processed in under 24 hours.

settings.question: What are the shipping options available?
settings.answer: Enjoy free standard shipping for orders totaling $35 or more, with delivery times ranging from 1 to 3 business days. We utilize USPS Priority Mail for all shipments to ensure prompt and reliable delivery. You can choose a preferred carrier at checkout.

settings.question: Where do you ship from?
settings.answer: All orders are shipped from our facility in Ontario, California. We take pride in dispatching our products from a centralized location to ensure efficient and timely deliveries.

settings.question: Do you accept returns or exchanges?
settings.answer: Unfortunately, due to food safety regulations, we are unable to accept returns or exchanges. However, if an error was made on our part, please contact us at support@coolmomsprinkles.com or chat with us on our website, and we will promptly address the issue. Our goal is for all customers to be 100% satisfied with their purchases.

settings.question: Do you offer international shipping?
settings.answer: Yes, we do offer international shipping. Please check our shipping options during the checkout process for rates and estimated delivery times.

settings.question: Need your order sooner?
settings.answer: For the fastest delivery speed, we recommend placing your order on Amazon. This ensures expedited processing and delivery, meeting your urgent needs.

settings.content: At Cool Mom Sprinkles, we are committed to providing a seamless shopping experience and top-notch customer satisfaction. If you have any further questions or concerns, feel free to reach out to us at info@coolmomsprinkles.com. Your joy in using our products is our utmost priority.
